title: A matrix opens as a page from the Matrices list, in view
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A opens as a page, not a dialog.
  • The grid is in view: it shows Edit, and no cell can be typed in.
  • The page title is matrix A's name.
  • Under the title a Categories line names category A.
  • The page has two tabs, Work Order Matrix and Part Sale Matrix.
  • Under the grid shows the Price Part Simulator.
  • The breadcrumb reads Pricing › Matrices › matrix A's name, with no separate Back link.
  • The breadcrumb starts at Pricing, with no Settings crumb before it.
